changes: Added context-aware proactive help that carries useful evidence across repeated work without exposing excluded apps
Memory and tasks now use one consistent system for every account while preserving existing memories and task history
Improved proactive notifications with adjustable active hours, persistent frequency and permission state, type-specific chat badges, and reliable message actions
Fixed a crash that could occur while refreshing the live voice context
Fixed a crash that could occur when opening exported memories in another app
Fixed desktop chat getting stuck after a local agent error
Fixed realtime voice audio recovery after an audio-device change
